Container.Name: fieldplan-app
Container.Overview: Fieldplan v2 — site CAD for low-voltage, electrical, security and smart-home installs, with user accounts, client share links, an audit log and a device catalog that imports products from vendor pages. Everything is stored in /data (SQLite database, uploaded files, auth secret) — back that folder up. Runs next to Fieldplan v1 on a different port. Open the Web UI once after the first start to create the admin account.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface (v1 uses 8095, Jellyfin 8096)

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, uploaded files and the sign-in secret. Back this up.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional. Lets Claude read product pages and datasheet PDFs during catalog import. Leave empty to turn this off.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Only when served through a reverse proxy, e.g. https://plans.example.com (no trailing slash). Leave empty for LAN use.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Number of reverse proxies in front (usually 1) so client IPs in the audit log are right. Leave empty for LAN use.

Config.Name: Claude model
Config.Description: Model used for imports; can also be changed in Settings

Config.Name: Claude daily limit
Config.Description: Most Claude calls per day (protects API credits); can also be changed in Settings

Config.Name: Allowed import sites
Config.Description: Comma-separated domains imports may fetch from, e.g. ui.com,reolink.com. Empty = any public site.
